title: Métriques métier — Supermarket Demo
description: Volumes métier calculés à partir des deltas des compteurs Prometheus sur la période sélectionnée.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total)

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) | EVAL total_requested = end - start

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) | EVAL total_completed = end - start

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) | EVAL restock_gap = (requested_end - requested_start) - (completed_end - completed_start)

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY bucket = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), channel = attributes.channel | EVAL channel_total = end - start | STATS total_orders = SUM(channel_total) BY bucket

SET unmapped_fields="NULLIFY"; FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | EVAL requested_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_requested_total), completed_counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_stock_restock_completed_total) | STATS requested_start = MIN(requested_counter), requested_end = MAX(requested_counter), completed_start = MIN(completed_counter), completed_end = MAX(completed_counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL requested = requested_end - requested_start, completed = completed_end - completed_start

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "rest" AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_orders = end - start

FROM metrics-prometheusreceiver.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND attributes.channel == "kafka" AND metrics.business_orders_completed_total IS NOT NULL | EVAL counter = TO_DOUBLE(metrics.business_orders_completed_total) | STATS start = MIN(counter), end = MAX(counter) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend) | EVAL total_orders = end - start
